purpose: Imagined tropical reading environment; not a depiction of hadith events

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original atmosphere illustration for a personal hadith reading app alongside the MindfulMod library. Create a wide landscape painterly illustration, refined gouache and oil texture, an inviting quiet tropical island reading veranda. View through a simple warm limestone arch toward a tranquil turquoise sea, distant leafy islands and a soft pale peach sky in late afternoon. Restrained carved Islamic geometric border on the arch, a palm and flowering vine framing one side, warm terracotta stone floor and a modest empty woven chair near the edge. Lush but restrained palette of olive foliage, warm ivory, muted turquoise, ochre and soft pink. Beautiful tangible warm light; restful spacious center, detailed brushwork at edges. No people, animals, religious figures, books with writing, lettering, calligraphy, logos or UI. This is an imagined reading environment, not a depiction of any event in a hadith. Landscape 1536 by 1024.

Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the supplied veranda illustration into a night companion for the same reading app. Preserve EXACT scene, architecture, islands, chair, plants, geometry and camera framing. Change only lighting and time of day: a quiet clear tropical night, deep muted teal and blue sky with sparse small stars, subtle distant moonlit sea, warm low amber lantern light grazing limestone and floor. Olive foliage, soft pink blossoms in shadow, restrained warm highlights. Keep painterly refined gouache/oil character. Relaxed, luminous and legible details, not excessively dark or bright. No people, lettering, calligraphy, logos or UI.
